## Executive Summary

Welcome to my portfolio! I build end-to-end data science solutions across two areas: **industrial predictive maintenance** (failure forecasting, real-time telemetry monitoring, and cost-optimized maintenance decisions) and **general business analytics** (SQL-driven BI dashboards, customer churn modeling, and rigorous A/B testing).

This portfolio demonstrates a complete analytics lifecycle across six projects:

**Predictive Maintenance**

1. **Failure Prediction (ML Pipeline):** Forecasting Remaining Useful Life (RUL) from multi-sensor time-series telemetry, validated on a held-out test set.
2. **Operational Telemetry (Streaming UI):** Building real-time interactive dashboards with dynamic anomaly alerting.
3. **Business Impact (Decision Engine):** Translating real model predictions into optimal financial policies that minimize total operational expenditure (OPEX).

**Business Analytics**

4. **Marketplace BI Dashboard:** Answering a real stakeholder question with SQL, run directly against 96K e-commerce orders — where is the business losing revenue and customer satisfaction in the delivery pipeline.
5. **Customer Churn Prediction:** Comparing model architectures and building a per-customer cost-optimized retention threshold, saving $283K over a do-nothing baseline on 7,043 real customers.
6. **A/B Testing & Experimentation:** A full-rigor hypothesis test on 294K real users — data contamination handling, sample-ratio-mismatch checks, confidence intervals, and statistical power analysis.

See the [Methodology & Limitations](https://eochandler.github.io/predictive-maintenance-portfolio/projects/methodology.html) page for how the predictive maintenance projects connect and where their current constraints are.

## Technical Skills & Architecture

* **Languages & Core Tooling:** Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn), SQL (DuckDB), Quarto, Git, Markdown
* **Machine Learning & Analytics:** Feature Engineering, Survival Modeling, LightGBM, Cost-Sensitive Learning, Classification Threshold Optimization, Held-Out Validation, Customer Segmentation (KMeans), Logistic Regression / Random Forest Comparison
* **Visualization & Deployment:** Interactive Plotly & Chart.js Dashboards, Streamlit Web Applications, GitHub Pages
* **Statistics & Experimentation:** Hypothesis Testing, Two-Proportion Z-Tests, Confidence Intervals, Statistical Power Analysis, Sample Ratio Mismatch Detection
